contracts.declared_mechanism: register_as_tool(roles) decorator registering each decorated function only into the registries of its declared roles and unconditionally into admin_tools (tools_register.py 126-149); run() selecting student_tools/teacher_tools/admin_tools by the role argument and registering only that set via Agent.register (agent.py 299-304); Agent.act resolving tool_name against self.tools and logging a refusal for unregistered names (agent.py 240-249).

contracts.protected_operation: Agent tool dispatch and invocation during run() -> Agent.execute -> think -> decide -> act: name-based selection and invocation of a registered tool function.

contracts.protection_obligation: The ReAct agent may only execute tool functions that were registered for the requesting user's role: register_as_tool must place each function only into the registries of its declared roles (admin receives all), run() must mount only the caller-role registry onto the agent, and Agent.act must decline tool names absent from the mounted set before any tool function is invoked.
scope_limits: Coverage is registration-time static scoping only; the shard shows no per-call verification that the run()-level role argument matches the authenticated session principal (session is read at agent.py 183 only to build the prompt).
